primary.$description: Primary brand color used for main CTAs, links, and active states.

secondary.$description: Purple 500 from the brand palette, used for supporting actions.

accent.$description: Accent color used sparingly for highlights and promotional callouts.

success.$description: Green 600 from the brand palette, used for successful actions or positive status.

warning.$description: Amber 600 from the brand palette, used for caution or states requiring attention.

danger.$description: Indicates destructive actions or error states.

info.$description: Blue 500 from the brand palette, used for informational, non-critical messaging.

white.$description: Pure white, used for surfaces and inverted text.

gray-100.$description: Lightest neutral gray, used for page backgrounds.

gray-300.$description: Light gray, used for borders and dividers.

gray-400.$description: Light gray, used for borders and dividers.

gray-500.$description: Mid gray, used for disabled text and placeholders.

gray-700.$description: Dark gray, used for secondary body text.

gray-900.$description: Darkest neutral, used for primary body text and headings.

black.$description: Pure black, used sparingly for maximum contrast needs.

muted.$description: Muted surface for cards and secondary panels.

inverse.$description: Text color used on dark/brand-colored backgrounds.

on-light-media.$description: Heading/label color for text overlaid on a light-toned photo or media background, paired with {color.text.inverse} for dark-toned media.

600.$description: Charcoal 600: decorative card borders and the editor canvas grid on charcoal surfaces. Too faint (1.5:1) for meaningful boundaries.

700.$description: Charcoal 700: raised or selected surfaces on charcoal, such as the active nav pill and an inactive progress track.

800.$description: Charcoal (base palette): cards, panels and menus on the Charcoal & Copper theme.

900.$description: Charcoal 900: page background, top bar and editor canvas on the Charcoal & Copper theme.

950.$description: Charcoal 950: text on copper (solid or brushed). Never put white text on copper.

300.$description: Copper 300 (light): brushed-gradient highlight and link hover on charcoal.

500.$description: Copper 500: solid copper for links, icons, focus rings, selection outlines and the current step. Text on Charcoal 900/800 only, not on Charcoal 700.

700.$description: Copper 700 (deep): brushed-gradient stop and pressed state.

900.$description: Copper 900 (deep brown): avatar and brand chip backgrounds.

300.$description: Neutral 300: secondary text and placeholders on charcoal (6.0:1).

400.$description: Neutral 400: form-control borders and other meaningful boundaries on charcoal (WCAG 1.4.11).
Green 400: success text and icons on charcoal.
Gold 400: warning text and icons on charcoal. Warm like copper, so always pair it with text or an icon.

100.$description: Rose 100: danger text on charcoal (Red 600 fails at 2.1:1).
